title: Keep component CSS nearby
summary: Styles in an Astro component are scoped by default.
introduction: Styles in an Astro component are scoped by default. Your task: Change the card padding.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for keep component css nearby

blocks.text: Styles in an Astro component are scoped by default. They can style that component without using a global rule for the whole site.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.
Read the code step by step

items: The style block belongs to this component.
The article rule defines the container, while the h2 rule changes only the matching heading style.

blocks.text: The article has a navy border and its heading is navy.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use an explicit global style only when it should affect the wider page. Do not make every rule global by accident.
